overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 108.80% annualised against 26.01% volatility (Sharpe 2.79) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 55.2%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.31% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.19% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -9.83%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 3.08%, 99% VaR 20.10%, CVaR 95% 13.11%. Probability of >20% loss: 1.01%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-66.66% return, max drawdown -67.35%, worst day -15.42%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 27.56% vs realised 27.08% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: XOM have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
